fact: The UNECA/GIZ/AU inception report says Banco de Moçambique Notice 4/GGBM/2003 requires data centres to be located in Mozambique, with replicas abroad allowed only with prior approval; it gives no repeal, and no date other than the 2003 notice and the report's publication of 2025-06-19.

INTIC's draft Regulamento dos Servicos de Computacao em Nuvem, in public consultation from 2025-02-24 (day inferred from the consultation window, the document's published date), says in Art. 11(2) that classified information may be handled only in private clouds and must always stay in national territory unless the regulator expressly authorises otherwise.
